---
name: Refactoring Proposal
about: Report a potential refactoring of the current code.
title: '[REFACTOR] '
labels: ['refactor', 'consider refactoring']
assignees: ''
---
### Proposal Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed refactoring.

### Proposal Goal/Contribution
Explain which aspect of the code should be improved and the expected benefits, such as readability, maintainability, or performance.

### Current Behavior
Describe how the affected code currently works and any challenges it presents.

### Expected Behavior
Describe how the code should look after the refactoring, including whether the behavior for users should remain unchanged.

### Suggested Testing
Specify which tests would verify that the refactoring works correctly and introduces no regressions.

### Affected Files or Components
List the parts of the project that could be affected by the proposal.
